items.risk: utoipa-swagger-ui egress 403 (#2966) renders api-server structurally unbuildable in the cloud runner — every backend-touching dispatcher task is CLOUD-BUILD-BLOCKED, including all 3 open cross-tenant IDOR retries (#2944/#2945/#2946). Security fixes are not landing because the toolchain can't compile, not because the fix is hard
items.mitigation: Vendor swagger-ui assets locally OR allowlist the egress target OR cache the dist in the sandbox base image — any of three. Blocks: all backend security PRs plus #2559 / #2555 accounting trio
items.trigger: Any dispatcher run with claimable<=10 AND >=2 open blocked-on-#2966 items

items.risk: Cross-tenant IDOR #2946 (portfolio_analytics property metrics computed org_id then discarded) is on retry 2/2 and still open — a tier-1 security defect that has survived two implementer attempts; a successful exploit returns per-property metrics across org boundaries
items.mitigation: Prioritize #2966 unblock; if infra slips, land #2946 fix locally and push a reviewed PR by hand; add a hand-written cross-tenant repro test as part of the fix PR so regression surfaces
items.trigger: retry 2/2 failing without a merged PR; or dispatcher record of 3+ failed-no-pr cycles

items.risk: @ppt/api-client has triplicated auth-header + MFA-retry logic across fetch primitives (gdprClient, paymentMatching, remaining consumers) — surfaced by post-merge review of PR #3004 and tracked as #3006. Three copies will drift (one will forget to attach MFA-retry on a 403; one will send a stale token; one will log the token). Classic security-overtones refactor target
items.mitigation: Collapse into a single shared `authenticatedFetchJson` primitive; add a biome rule to forbid new fetch primitives that do not import from the shared module
items.trigger: Any new PR introducing a 4th auth-header path, OR an MFA regression caught post-merge

items.risk: Accounting MVP-loop trio (#2555 / #2558 / #2559) has been sitting at 64d with no reviewer engagement — dispatcher stack is still starving on reviewer capacity, not implementer capacity. Risk is now aging past the 'review by October' commitment captured in the sprint retro
items.mitigation: Explicit reviewer slot for the trio next 24h; document reviewer-slot rotation policy for large-scope feature PRs

items.risk: The reality-web UI has shipped at least three screens that silently drop user-entered data on the floor (dead /report attachment control — #3017/#3019; dead /sell seller-contact fields — #3016/#3022; silent PriceAlerts mark-read failure — #3021). All three were spotted by post-merge churn-hotspot review, not by test. The frontend has no end-to-end data-contract assertion that "form field X ends up in network payload Y" — same class will keep recurring on new wizard screens
items.mitigation: Introduce a vitest helper (frontend/packages/testing-helpers) that mounts a form, submits it against an msw handler, and diff-asserts form-schema vs captured request body; pilot on /sell + /report; add CI gate for any new wizard page under reality-web
items.trigger: Any new reality-web wizard page merges without a data-contract assertion test

items.risk: assignments.json carries a growing corpus of reviewer_summary.verdict=changes notes (12 open at this snapshot) that holds structured signal about recurring defect classes — scope-drift, i18n drift, screen-map staleness, self-approval-blocked etc. — but nothing aggregates it. The dispatcher sees per-PR noise; project-management sees nothing. Trend data is dark
items.mitigation: Add a daily jq-based bucket counter (reviewer note → tag), emit a 1-line summary into project-state.md; retire if signal is thin after 2 weeks
items.trigger: assignments.json verdict=changes count >= 10 and no aggregation report exists
